title: Apache superset: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python (CVE-2025-69223)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability (CVE-2025-69223) affects the apache-superset package, specifically related to the AIOHTTP asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. The vulnerability impacts availability without compromising confidentiality or integrity. Fixed versions 2021.38.2-r0 and 2021.36.5-r0 are available.
